policy.source_relation: Presence is not claim verification; candidate/supporting labels are not approval.
policy.images: Optional, never blocks a text profile.
policy.video_dimensions: SOURCE_OK/URL_OK/TITLE_OK/RELATION_OK overlap; do not sum them as partitions.
policy.current_public: Current published counts are reported independently; audit does not unpublish.
